HOME INCOMING International Summer School
WHY Hanyang International Summer School(HISS)?
 
 

Overview

 
  • 1. Great Location at the Heart of Seoul
  • With its own subway station connected directly to the campus (Hanyang University, Line #2)
  • 2. Selection of Up To 3 Courses (at Flat Fee)
  • From +130 courses across 12 different disciplines, taught by leading scholars all in English.
  • 3. Attractive Price with Available Scholarships
  • Variety of scholarships available including Active Partner Scholarship of 40% discount on tuition fee.
  • 4. Biggest Summer School with Reputable Global Network
  • Global network with +2000 students of +45 nationalities and +12,000 HISS alumni
  • 5. Complimentary Activities for a Taste of Korea
  • 6 Cultural / social activities for the first-hand experience of trendy Korean culture
  • 6. Buddy Program for Your Seoul-full Stay
  • Volunteering Hanyang domestic students to ensure your comfortable stay at Seoul.
  • 7. Research Opportunity at Engine of Korea
  • Cutting edge research centers and lab for Research Project presented by Korea’s 1st Engineering college.
